content.title: What March Madness games are on today? Schedule, TV, tipoff times for Elite Eight of NCAA men’s tournament - NBC Sports
content.text: The NCAA men’s basketball tournament is one step away from setting the 2026 Final Four Field as the Elite Eight begins Saturday night. In a Big Ten matchup Saturday, Illinois will play Iowa at 6:09 p.m. ET in the South Region final. Big Ten tournament champion Purdue will face Arizona at 8:49 p.m. ET in the West Region final.On Sunday, Michigan will play Tennessee at 2:15 p.m. ET in the Midwest Region final. Duke will face UConn at 5:05 p.m. ET on the East.See below for the Elite Eight matchups, along with additional information on how to watch the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament. As the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament begins this week, here’s a guide to who’s playing.
